editorial:
If you love action movies where the hero punches first and asks questions later, this one is a blast. Ma Seok-do, nicknamed the Beast Cop, travels to Vietnam to bring back a suspect, but he quickly stumbles onto a string of murders targeting tourists. The killer, Kang Hae-sang, is cold, ruthless, and has been getting away with it for years. What follows is a fast, funny, and brutal ride as Ma and his team chase him across borders. The movie mixes hard-hitting fights with sharp humor, and Ma Dong-seok's charm carries every scene. You will laugh at the banter and wince at the punches in equal measure.

The action is the real star here. Fights feel heavy and real, and the pacing rarely slows down. Son Suk-ku makes a terrifying villain, while the supporting cops add great comic relief. On the downside, the story is pretty simple and some side characters feel thin. Still, if you want pure entertainment with no deep thinking required, this delivers.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Ma Seok-do tracks Kang Hae-sang to Vietnam and beats him in a brutal hand-to-hand fight. Kang is arrested and brought back to Korea to face justice. The original suspect Ma came to extradite is also dealt with, and the tourist murder case is finally closed. Ma and his team return home as heroes, with the Beast Cop's legend growing even bigger.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action-packed crime thrillers with humor and a tough hero.
